text:
maria: Quick heads-up — planning a 60m retro for the recent infra incident. Thinking Wed 10:00am PT. Who needs to be on the invite and any must-have agenda items? :calendar:
aj: SRE + oncall leads for sure. Also include PM and the owner of the deploy pipeline.
sam_g: Works for me at 10. Please include a short pre-read (timeline + root-cause notes) so we can be efficient.
lina: I can facili- wait — are we rotating facilitators this quarter? I'm happy to take this one if so.
kevin: 10:30 would be marginally better for me — 10 conflicts with daily sync. Could we do 10:30?
maria: 10:30 okay if it gets more attendance. Want to keep it 60m though.
harpreet: +1 for 10:30. Also can someone add a quick bug scrub item to confirm follow-ups get triaged in backlog?
maria: Good call. Draft agenda below — please comment/edit.
```
Retro agenda (60m)
- 5m: Quick context & pre-read recap
- 10m: Timeline & facts (who did what when)
- 15m: What went well
- 15m: What to improve / root causes
- 10m: Action items, owners, and timeboxes
- (optional) 5m: Follow-up scheduling
```
aj: Maybe explicitly call out 'observability gaps' under 'What to improve'.
sam_g: I'll put together the timeline + attach logs. Assign to @sam_g for pre-read.
harpreet: I'll update the action tracker after the meeting and I've got next-week capacity to triage the first set of items. assign to @harpreet.
lina: I'd like to try a shorter facilitation script — timebox the brainstorm sections and capture owners inline. If folks agree I can run it.
kevin: Fine with lina facilitating. :+1:
maria: OK — lina facilitator, sam_g timeline/pre-read, harpreet action tracker / triage follow-up. I'll create the calendar invite for Wed 10:30am PT and add SRE, oncall, PM, infra eng, and kevin.
devops-bot: Calendar event created: "Infra incident retro" — Wed 10:30am PT — Invitees: @sre-oncall, @pm-ops, @maria, @lina, @kevin, @sam_g, @harpreet
maria: Thanks — please react with :thumbsup: if you can attend, or reply here if you can't. I'll post the pre-read by EOD tomorrow.
aj: :thumbsup:
sam_g: :thumbsup:
lina: :thumbsup:
kevin: Can't make 10:30 — moving to tentative and will send a note to accept if I can free the slot.
harpreet: :thumbsup:
